questions.lesson_title: Check Your Understanding - Inter-VLAN Routing Operation
questions.question: Refer to each of the scenario topologies . Which statements best describe the different types of inter-VLAN routing solutions? (Choose all that apply.)

options.text: Scenario A is a legacy inter-VLAN solution.
Scenario B is a Layer 3 inter-VLAN solution.
Scenario B and C are both Router-on-a-stick inter-VLAN solutions.
Scenario A is a Layer 3 inter-VLAN solution.
Scenario B is a legacy inter-VLAN solution.
Scenario C is a router-on-a-stick inter-VLAN solution.

correct_texts: Scenario A is a Layer 3 inter-VLAN solution.
Scenario B is a legacy inter-VLAN solution.
Scenario C is a router-on-a-stick inter-VLAN solution.
